ANNOUNCEMENT
A SIMPLE ROUTINE

Ready here. Sent in WhatsApp.

01Set up your recipients once.Add the international WhatsApp number for each mahber. Cloud mode shares your private details across your signed-in devices.

02Open an announcement.Zoom text opens prefilled in the saved private chat. For posters, use Share poster and choose WhatsApp and the saved contact. The original Canva images are already included.

03Send, then mark it sent.Press Send inside WhatsApp, return here, and mark the announcement sent. Opening a chat or share menu does not confirm delivery.

This frontend app shows your schedule when you open it. It cannot send unattended or send while closed. Automatic delivery needs a server and an approved WhatsApp Business integration.

Poster deadlines are three calendar days before the meeting; Zoom invitations are one calendar day before. All dates follow Dubai time.
